title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-27
source: Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)> Tim Dalton's PCM (Sony SLHF400/Sony HG betamax tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with uneven mix levels, yet it captures a high‑energy show highlighted by Jerry’s left‑side presence and a Phil‑centric “zone.”
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered fondly for its intense atmosphere – Jerry playing on the left side of the stage and Phil taking the lead both left strong impressions on fans. However, listeners note that the recording suffers from uneven levels and PA/technical issues throughout, making the sound quality only fair despite the vibrant performance.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates it 5 stars for the memorable show while another gives 3 stars citing technical mix problems; the average yields a solid 4‑star rating with moderate confidence due to only two mixed reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix/level/PA issues are noted throughout, with uneven volume levels that affect clarity.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry’s move to the left side of the stage created a “crazy screaming” presence that seemed to fill the reviewer’s ear.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil is described as the driving force, with his vocals and bass work highlighted as the start of a personal “phil zone.”
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboardist) is mentioned in relation to stage positioning and later departure.
